question:

solution:
The logic followed here is :

1) Both the elements at one side and the center element shift clockwise. 

2) Here, first the elements at top side are shifted, then the next pair elements shift in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8ff9fe4a22ce760abaac568f8bb58dd19cfb9b1cd406fd21d10ebc29b9468f0.png] 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea35b59cd020caaa0d09d03748b7031ee6ad71b9727c86467686d202b3bc657b.png]
